contexts.text: He joineth together His chambers with beams in the waters ()... The chambers which He joineth together with beams in the waters = the heavenly Societies.
To join together His chambers with beams in the waters = to fill those who are in the ultimate Heaven and those who are in the Church with Knowledges of truth and good.
He joineth together His chambers with beams in the waters = that the Lord forms the Heavens and the Church by Divine truths... The chambers of Jehovah = the Heavens and the Church.
